# 解法

三次方程为 $a_3 x^3 - x^2 + a_1 x - 7 = 0$，其正实根为 $\alpha, \beta, \gamma$。根据韦达定理：

$$\alpha+\beta+\gamma = \tfrac{1}{a_3},\quad \alpha\beta+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma = \tfrac{a_1}{a_3},\quad \alpha\beta\gamma = \tfrac{7}{a_3}.$$

根据后两个关系式，$a_1 = \dfrac{7(\alpha\beta+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma)}{\alpha\beta\gamma} = 7\!\left(\tfrac{1}{\alpha}+\tfrac{1}{\beta}+\tfrac{1}{\gamma}\right)$。

根据前两个关系式，$\alpha\beta\gamma = 7(\alpha+\beta+\gamma)$。

## 设定

设 $s = 1/\alpha,\ t = 1/\beta,\ u = 1/\gamma$。效率条件 $\dfrac{225\alpha^2}{\alpha^2+7}=\dfrac{144\beta^2}{\beta^2+7}=\dfrac{100\gamma^2}{\gamma^2+7}=k$ 可转化为：

$$s^2 = \frac{225-k}{7k},\quad t^2=\frac{144-k}{7k},\quad u^2=\frac{100-k}{7k}.$$

约束条件 $\alpha\beta\gamma = 7(\alpha+\beta+\gamma)$ 两边同除以 $\alpha\beta\gamma$ 得到：

$$st+su+tu = \tfrac{1}{7}.\quad(\text{III})$$

根据 $s^2,t^2,u^2$ 的公式消去 $k$：

$$112\,s^2 - 175\,t^2 = 9,\quad 175\,t^2 - 252\,u^2 = 11.\quad\text{(I),(II)}$$

## 求解

我猜测 $s = 3/7$。验证 (I)：$112\cdot\tfrac{9}{49}-175\,t^2 = 9 \Rightarrow \tfrac{144}{7}-175\,t^2=9 \Rightarrow 175\,t^2=\tfrac{81}{7} \Rightarrow t^2=\tfrac{81}{1225}=\left(\tfrac{9}{35}\right)^2$，因此 $t=\tfrac{9}{35}$。

验证 (II)：$175\cdot\tfrac{81}{1225}-252\,u^2=11 \Rightarrow \tfrac{81}{7}-252\,u^2=11 \Rightarrow 252\,u^2=\tfrac{77}{7}=11 \Rightarrow u^2=\tfrac{11}{252}=\tfrac{1}{22.9...}$。实际上 $252\,u^2=11 \Rightarrow u^2=\tfrac{11}{252}$。检查：$\tfrac{11}{252}=\tfrac{11}{252}$，且 $\sqrt{252}=\sqrt{4\cdot63}=2\sqrt{63}$。嗯，让我重新计算：$u^2 = 11/252$。$11/252 = 11/(4\cdot63) = 11/(4\cdot9\cdot7) = 11/(252)$。$\sqrt{11/252}$ — 是 $1/21$ 吗？$(1/21)^2 = 1/441$。$11/252 \ne 1/441$。让我重新验证。

$175\,t^2 - 252\,u^2 = 11$：$175\cdot 81/1225 = 81/7$。$81/7 - 252\,u^2 = 11 \Rightarrow 252\,u^2 = 81/7 - 11 = 81/7-77/7 = 4/7 \Rightarrow u^2 = 4/(7\cdot252) = 4/1764 = 1/441 = (1/21)^2$。因此 $u = 1/21$ ✓。

验证 (III)：$st+su+tu = \tfrac{3}{7}\cdot\tfrac{9}{35}+\tfrac{3}{7}\cdot\tfrac{1}{21}+\tfrac{9}{35}\cdot\tfrac{1}{21} = \tfrac{27}{245}+\tfrac{3}{147}+\tfrac{9}{735} = \tfrac{81+15+9}{735}=\tfrac{105}{735}=\tfrac{1}{7}$ ✓。

## 结果

$$a_1 = 7(s+t+u) = 7\!\left(\tfrac{3}{7}+\tfrac{9}{35}+\tfrac{1}{21}\right) = 7\cdot\tfrac{45+27+5}{105}=7\cdot\tfrac{77}{105}=\tfrac{77}{15}.$$

**验证：** $\alpha=7/3,\ \beta=35/9,\ \gamma=21$。效率比值：$\tfrac{225\cdot49/9}{49/9+7}=\tfrac{11025}{112}=\tfrac{1575}{16}$；$\tfrac{144\cdot1225/81}{1225/81+7}=\tfrac{176400}{1792}=\tfrac{1575}{16}$；$\tfrac{100\cdot441}{448}=\tfrac{1575}{16}$ ✓。韦达定理：$\alpha\beta\gamma=\tfrac{5145}{27}=\tfrac{1715}{9}=7\cdot\tfrac{245}{9}=7(\alpha+\beta+\gamma)$ ✓。

$a_1 = \tfrac{77}{15}$ 是既约分数（$\gcd(77,15)=1$），因此 $a+b = 77+15 = \boxed{92}$。
